preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10**4 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit() and int(line.strip()) == n)
preconditions.description: The first line of each test case is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^4) representing the array size.

preconditions.expression: all(len(a) == n and all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**5 for x in a) for a in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]])
preconditions.description: Each test case's second line contains n positive integers a_1, ..., a_n (1 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^5).
The first line of stdin is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10^4) representing the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_line.strip() == '-1' or (stdout_line.strip().isdigit() and 0 <= int(stdout_line.strip()) <= 3 * n)) for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout_line.strip() != '')
postconditions.description: For each test case, the first line of output is either -1 (no solution) or an integer k (0 ≤ k ≤ 3n) representing the number of operations.

postconditions.expression: all((k_line.strip() == '-1' or (k_line.strip().isdigit() and 0 <= int(k_line.strip()) <= 3 * n)) and (k_line.strip() != '-1' implies (k_line.strip().isdigit() and 0 <= int(k_line.strip()) <= 3 * n and len(operations) == int(k_line.strip())) for k_line, operations in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [stdout.splitlines()[i+1:i+1+int(stdout.splitlines()[i])] for i in range(0, len(stdout.splitlines()), int(stdout.splitlines()[i])+1) if i < len(stdout.splitlines()) and stdout.splitlines()[i].strip().isdigit()]))
postconditions.description: If k > 0, the next k lines must contain exactly three integers i, j, x (1 ≤ i, j ≤ n; 0 ≤ x ≤ 10^9) per operation, representing valid operations.

postconditions.expression: all((k_line.strip() == '-1' or (k_line.strip().isdigit() and 0 <= int(k_line.strip()) <= 3 * n and all(1 <= int(i) <= n and 1 <= int(j) <= n and 0 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for i, j, x in [op.split() for op in operations])) for k_line, operations in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [stdout.splitlines()[i+1:i+1+int(stdout.splitlines()[i])] for i in range(0, len(stdout.splitlines()), int(stdout.splitlines()[i])+1) if i < len(stdout.splitlines()) and stdout.splitlines()[i].strip().isdigit()]))
postconditions.description: Each operation must satisfy 1 ≤ i, j ≤ n and 0 ≤ x ≤ 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all((k_line.strip() == '-1' or (k_line.strip().isdigit() and 0 <= int(k_line.strip()) <= 3 * n and all(all(0 <= a[i] for i in range(n)) for a in [list(map(int, a_line.split())) for a_line in [stdout.splitlines()[0]] + [stdout.splitlines()[i+1:i+1+int(stdout.splitlines()[i])] for i in range(0, len(stdout.splitlines()), int(stdout.splitlines()[i])+1) if i < len(stdout.splitlines()) and stdout.splitlines()[i].strip().isdigit()]])) for k_line in stdout.splitlines() if k_line.strip().isdigit())
postconditions.description: After each operation, all elements of the array must remain non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all((k_line.strip() == '-1' or (k_line.strip().isdigit() and 0 <= int(k_line.strip()) <= 3 * n and all(all(a[i] == a[0] for i in range(1, n)) for a in [list(map(int, a_line.split())) for a_line in [stdout.splitlines()[0]] + [stdout.splitlines()[i+1:i+1+int(stdout.splitlines()[i])] for i in range(0, len(stdout.splitlines()), int(stdout.splitlines()[i])+1) if i < len(stdout.splitlines()) and stdout.splitlines()[i].strip().isdigit()]])) for k_line in stdout.splitlines() if k_line.strip().isdigit())
postconditions.description: If k > 0, after performing all operations, all elements of the array must be equal.
